name: db-browser-workspace
description: Monorepo for @jugaaadi/db-browser — a reusable database browser library built on @jugaaadi/table.

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build -w @jugaaadi/db-browser-demo
scripts.build:lib: npm run build -w @jugaaadi/db-browser && npm run build -w @jugaaadi/db-browser-connectors && npm run build -w @jugaaadi/db-browser-pg && npm run build -w @jugaaadi/db-browser-sqlite
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @jugaaadi/db-browser && npm run typecheck -w @jugaaadi/db-browser-connectors && npm run typecheck -w @jugaaadi/db-browser-pg && npm run typecheck -w @jugaaadi/db-browser-sqlite && npm run typecheck -w @jugaaadi/db-browser-demo
